preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Run each post-commit Git probe separately with login-shell initialization disabled.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Run large-checkout post-commit Git probes as isolated no-login commands and preserve each native exit status.
preferred_methods.rollback: Discard the incomplete grouped result and leave repository and remote state unchanged.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Read-only post-commit attribution only; the recovery does not add test or reproduction credit.
preferred_methods.title: Isolated no-login post-commit Git verification

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Use explicit directory roots and ripgrep -g filters instead of wildcard path operands.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Use explicit Windows roots with ripgrep -g filters and retain every recurrence as a separate failed witness.
preferred_methods.rollback: Discard literal-wildcard results and leave repository content unchanged.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Read-only file inventory only; corrected matches do not establish broader semantic completeness.
preferred_methods.title: Explicit-root Windows ripgrep inventories

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Inventory generated files explicitly before selecting record and witness paths.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Inventory generated filenames explicitly before reading them; do not infer prefixes from method identifiers.
preferred_methods.rollback: Treat all missing-path reads as failed assumptions and leave repository content unchanged.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Generated-file attribution only; no Method Flow semantic credit follows from filename discovery alone.
preferred_methods.title: Explicit generated Method Flow filename discovery

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Bind the repository root in sys.path before loading named repository test modules.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Bind in-process test discovery to the repository root and reject placeholder-only module counts before consuming a pass budget.
preferred_methods.rollback: Treat the provisional count as invalid, run no tests, and leave the canonical pass budget unused.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Test discovery only; a corrected count is not a test pass.
preferred_methods.title: Repository-root-bound unittest discovery
trigger_preconditions: canonical pass budget not yet used

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Import every named test module explicitly and select the actual inherited x1 and x2 modules from the immutable test-file inventory.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Explicitly import every named module before suite construction and reject any inferred selector absent from the exact test-file inventory.
preferred_methods.rollback: Give the failed attempt zero canonical-pass credit, preserve its receipt, and keep successful_passes_used at zero.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Authorized scoped-test selection only; correction may not broaden to the full repository suite or erase the failed attempt.
preferred_methods.title: Import-complete inherited scoped-test selection
